_comment: ICT Form 2 Learner's Book. Rebuilt 2026-10-23 on the current engine, matched to the Teacher's Guide (PR #95): LEARNINING/Alterative typos corrected; Foreword signatory title in capitals like the Preface and Acknowledgement ones; glossary and references set a little tighter together (backmatterSpacing); the two Excel screenshots (Exercises 8 and 12) drawn as spreadsheet grids, values as in the screenshots (Sn reads 2-6, left for the author); three page breaks: the Creating Columns figure kept with its label, End of Topic 2.2 Q9 taken over with Q10, Learning Activity 19 starts a page.
2026-10-28: 'subtopic' (33x in the body) spelled 'sub-topic' like the headings and the Teacher's Guide (user's choice).

2026-11-06: post-CDC manuscript (blue text deleted, yellow added, green Activities 3, 4, 7 kept, all highlights and comments stripped). Pictures renumbered in the new .docx, so images and imageToTable keys were re-pointed by content hash.
2026-11-06: Figure 29 reuses Figure 28 (user decision): the manuscript had the create-account picture of Figure 27 cut in two (image38 + image39).
2026-11-06: front matter to the house pattern, as the TG: signatories name bold, title plain, organisation bold capitals; imprint Cover and Book Layout, ISBN after the publisher, one publisher name.

2026-11-06: user asked for the slips fixed: table captions numbered 1-90 in order (no Table 38, 45 and 48 doubled; no text refers to a table by number), Exercise 8 Sn 1-5, stray label in Exercise 2 removed.
